data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to support haptic feedback with custom patterns.
data.what_it_does: Provides haptic feedback effects like success, error, warning, heavy, light, and custom patterns using .ahap files on Android and iOS.
use_when: You want to add tactile haptic feedback to user interactions like button taps or events.
You need custom vibration patterns using .ahap files.
avoid_when: You only need standard device information or sensor tracking.
strengths: Supports custom .ahap patterns on both Android and iOS.
weaknesses: Custom vibration patterns are only supported on iPhone 8 and newer devices.
Some advanced pattern features like AttackTime and DecayTime are still on the roadmap.

alternatives.name: vibration
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need simple device vibration control without advanced haptic feedback patterns.
